summary: Learn to design data operating models, governance, and roadmaps. Build practical tools for better decisions, alignment, and delivery.
lede: Data strategy and operating model design helps you connect business priorities with clear decision rights, accountability, governance, and delivery routines. Using the Galbraith Star Model and target operating model thinking, you will learn to shape structures that support trusted data, stronger analytics delivery, and visible value from data investment. You will assess the current state, build a capability map, define governance forums, draft a future-state operating model blueprint, and create a roadmap for manageable releases. Practical templates and scenario-based exercises address budget pressure, uneven data maturity, fragmented ownership, and the changing role of AI-assisted metadata management and automated data quality monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape data priorities, govern enterprise information flows, and turn strategy into an operating model that can be executed across business and technology teams.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of data management, analytics, or enterprise technology environments. Familiarity with operating model concepts, governance forums, or transformation planning will help you move faster, but no coding or programming is required. The course is taught at an intermediate level, and the advanced content is presented at an operational design level, not at technical engineering depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
